title: China's population falls again

population.evidence_excerpt: China's population fell to 1.416 billion people in 2025.

births.evidence_excerpt: China's crude birth rate was 6.77 births per 1,000 people in 2025.

deaths.evidence_excerpt: China's crude death rate was 7.58 deaths per 1,000 people in 2025.

total_fertility_rate.evidence_excerpt: China's total fertility rate was one birth per woman in 2025.

comments: BBC reporting says this is a WPP projection, although this is not a UN source.
